nights.title: Help Wanted
nights.intro:
Bartholomew[happy]: A third floor! And a new sort of guest: the kind that changes the rooms around it.
Bartholomew: Wren glows. Any room next to Wren stops being Dark. Mind who you put beside it.
Bartholomew: Oh, and we can afford staff now. Have a look in the Lobby tomorrow.

tutorial.text: Wren has an AURA. Rooms next to Wren lose their Dark tag. Temporary tags get a violet ring.

nights.title: The Clock Strikes
nights.intro:
Bartholomew[sad]: It's that time of year. At midnight, the hotel... does things. Pipes burst. Lights fail.
Bartholomew: You'll get a Swap Token to fix whatever goes wrong. Spend it wisely.

nights.title: Two Little Lights
nights.intro: Bartholomew: Ivy only wants to be next to Wren. Some guests want a particular neighbour, not just any neighbour.

tutorial.text: New rule: Next to someone. Ivy wants Wren in a room beside hers.

nights.title: A Gentleman Calls
nights.intro: Bartholomew[sad]: There's a man at the door. Polished shoes. He doesn't knock, he just... waits.
nights.vaneOffer:
Mr. Vane[happy]: Good evening. Ellis, isn't it? Edith's grandchild. My condolences on the inheritance.
Mr. Vane: I collect old buildings. And their contents. I'd pay handsomely for one small thing: your guest list.
Mr. Vane: A little Ectoplasm now, for a name or two. Nobody need know.
> Take his money | Show him the door

tutorial.text: Some guests have a HIDDEN rule. You only see a hint. Break it, and it costs a star at dawn.

nights.title: Banshee in the Belfry
nights.intro: Bartholomew: Two banshees tonight. Their screech goes straight up and down through the floors, never sideways.

nights.title: Power Cut
nights.intro: Bartholomew[sad]: Mr. Vane walked the corridors this afternoon. Measuring. Smiling.

nights.title: Riddle of the Stranger
nights.intro: Bartholomew: A veiled guest. Won't give a name, won't say what they need. Only riddles.

tutorial.text: A RIDDLE night. Read the Stranger's clues and work out their rules. Their stars stay hidden until dawn.

nights.title: The Fourth Floor
nights.intro: Bartholomew[happy]: The fourth floor's open! Mind your step, the banister's original. 1887. Mostly woodworm.

nights.title: Seance
nights.intro: Bartholomew[sad]: Someone's lit candles in the cellar. A séance. They're trying to reach Edith.

nights.title: Rush Night II
nights.intro: Bartholomew[happy]: The lake fog's back and everyone wants a room! Lots of guests, nothing too tricky.

nights.title: The Second Offer
nights.vaneOffer:
Mr. Vane: Ellis. You turned me down, or you didn't. Either way, I'm a patient man.
Mr. Vane[happy]: Old Salt. The banshees. The knight in the cellar. They'd fetch a fine price in the right collection.
Mr. Vane: Just sign here. A deposit on the deed. Nothing binding.
> Sign | Tear it up

nights.title: Unexpected Guest
nights.intro: Bartholomew: Quiet night. I'll just pop out for a minute, see if anyone's at the gate...

midnight.description: Bartholomew locked himself out. Find him an empty room, or leave him in the snow.

nights.title: The Stranger Returns
nights.intro: Bartholomew: The veiled one's back. Same riddles. Do you know, I think I know that voice.

nights.title: The Long Night
nights.intro: Bartholomew[sad]: Everything's creaking tonight. Brace yourself, keeper.

nights.title: Grand Night: The Door Below
nights.intro: Bartholomew: Every room, every guest. And Greaves says the door under the cellar has started to knock back.
nights.ledgerPage:
Ellis, love. If you've found this one, you've found the door.
Vane isn't a developer. He's a collector, and the in-between is his warehouse.
Every ghost who moves on is one he can't sell. That's why he wants the hotel.
I went through to stop him. I'm still here. Keep going.
— E.
